notes.title: THE POOP ON 2020 PODCAST! Now available for FREEEEEEEEEEEEE!
notes.content:
Hey poop fam, it's ya boy Mandel.

I'm very happy to announce that I have made ZERO changes to the game, but am releasing the audio from the secret podcast that's in the game! Thanks, [b]Stefan8000[/b], for the idea!

So here it is for free download: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1433480/Poop_On_2020_Simulator/][b]The POOP ON 2020 PODCAST![/b][/url]

Now you can listen to the dulcet tones of two grown men making poop jokes from [b]ANY MP3-COMPATIBLE DEVICE OF YOUR HEART'S CHOOSING![/b]

Features include:
[list]
[*][b]NOT [/b]having to play the game to listen!
[*]Being able to [b]FAST FORWARD[/b] to any section at the click of a hand-based mouse-type device!
[*]Download the file to [b]ANYTHING [/b](don't ask me how).
[*]That's it!
[/list]

And of course, I want to personally thank the approximately 350 of you who knowingly bought this game and paid real money, as well as the approximately 40 of you who immediately took said money back after pooping once on 2020.

I couldn't have done this without you. ːsteamhappyː

A great many poops,
Mandel

notes.title: FINALLY! The 2021 UPDATE IS HERE! AND A SALE!
notes.content:
GREETINGS HUMANS. As you may well know, the year 2020 is wrapping. And that could mean this game is already irrelevant and out of date. Well let me tell you that is not the case!

I've just updated the game with all kinds of new additions, including:
[list]
[*] A 2021 that you can poop on!
[*] Politicians that you can throw!
[*] 100% more music and sound effects!
[*] COVID-19 that you can also poop on!
[*] Confetti cannons!
[*] and an additional 17 unique Achievements to get excited about!
[/list]

And lastly, POOP ON 2020 SIMULATOR will be on sale at the beginning of 2021!
That's right folks! Just like a pile of 2020 daily planners, [b]EVERYTHING MUST GO![/b] 

It's 50% for the first 7 days of 2021!


But seriously, thank you to all the folks who've bought this silly little game, not knowing what you'd be getting into but trusting in the process. And now 2020 is wrapping up, and I'm gonna take a break from updating PO2020S for a little bit. I've got big plans in the new year so stay tuned!

May you flush 2020 down the drain and have it never come back up through the pipes.

Love and poops,
Mandel

notes.title: A LIMITED-TIME EVENT To Celebrate Non-Denominational Holiday Festivities
notes.content:
Greetings and Happy Holidays to the [b]DOZENS [/b]of folks out there who have pooped on 2020. It's been a wonderful ride this year, but it's not done yet!

I was playing Red Dead Online and they had a special event where there was snow everywhere. Well, you know what, I could do better! Triple A game studios aren't the only ones who can add completely cosmetic updates to their games! I can too! Prepare for a minor update that will blow your socks off!

I've updated [b]POOP ON 2020 SIMULATOR[/b] in the following manner:
[list]
[*][b]SNOW [/b]flurries down and melts away, just like Mother Nature intended.
[*]Changed the music to be a totally holiday themed with [b]SLEIGH BELLS[/b].
[*]Figured out how to add [b]DEPTH OF FIELD[/b] when you go to the menu screen... oh, the [b]REALISM[/b].
[*]Audio balance tweaks because [b]WHY NOT[/b].
[/list]

Additionally, I started to lay down the foundation for the next [b]FREE UPDATE[/b] that will happen on [b]NEW YEARS EVE[/b] when the clock strikes 12am PDT, and the [b]WORST YEAR EVER[/b] is finally over!

If you have fix requests, just let me know at game.games.gamedev@gmail.com.
May your poops be swift and comfortable,

_Mandel
